nodes.label: Damaged instances.json/settings.json kept as .broken-<time>
nodes.rationale: Prevents overwriting user data with an empty list on next save when parsing fails or file came from a newer version.

nodes.label: Download stall timeout (90 s) and partial-file cleanup
nodes.norm_label: download stall timeout (90 s) and partial-file cleanup

nodes.label: Delete only real list entries (no empty or .. names)
nodes.norm_label: delete only real list entries (no empty or .. names)
nodes.rationale: Path traversal guard so deleting versions, jars, backups or mods can't reach the parent folder.

nodes.label: Per-instance task exclusivity (no double start, no concurrent backup/restore/switch)
nodes.norm_label: per-instance task exclusivity (no double start, no concurrent backup/restore/switch)
nodes.rationale: Double Start clicks launched two copies; update restarts were refused by their own still-running task; tasks on one instance must not overlap.

nodes.label: Linux never links GTK/WebKit (one binary)
nodes.rationale: wry/tao are non-Linux deps so one Linux binary serves desktops and servers; Linux desktop uses a Chromium --app window.

nodes.label: LiveView sessions offload long work to main runtime (run_job, spawn_task, state.notify)
nodes.norm_label: liveview sessions offload long work to main runtime (run_job, spawn_task, state.notify)

nodes.label: Never hold a parking_lot guard across .await
nodes.norm_label: never hold a parking_lot guard across .await

nodes.label: Server processes end with Hyve (job object / PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, stop_all)
nodes.norm_label: server processes end with hyve (job object / pr_set_pdeathsig, stop_all)

nodes.label: Always bump version, verify, commit rule
nodes.norm_label: always bump version, verify, commit rule
nodes.rationale: Owner wants every change set to ship as a release; pushing stays the user's call.

nodes.label: Rename HyOrchestrator to Hyve (0.4) compatibility
nodes.rationale: Keeps AppId, old data folder and hyo_token cookie so existing installs keep working.

nodes.label: Server sign-in order (saved account token passthrough, else device prompt)
nodes.norm_label: server sign-in order (saved account token passthrough, else device prompt)
nodes.rationale: Tokens go in env vars, never in logged arguments.

nodes.label: Exactly 3 binaries per release (Hyve-setup.exe, hyve-linux-x64, hyve-macos-arm64)
nodes.norm_label: exactly 3 binaries per release (hyve-setup.exe, hyve-linux-x64, hyve-macos-arm64)
nodes.rationale: Owner's rule: same file for install and update; installed copies read these names via updater::asset_name.
